title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging Sales and Revenue executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email sales executives (VP of Sales, Head of Sales, Chief Revenue Officer, CEO) to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

title: Talent Manager(Non Code)
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements).
  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams.
  • Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed.
  • Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines.
  • Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations.
  • Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing.
  • Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding.
  • Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management.
  • Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive).


Preferred Experience

  • Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding.
  • Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards.
  • Experience in high-growth or startup environments.


Soft Skills

  • Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments.
  • Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy.
  • Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines.


Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is fully remote and CLT model and salary range is 20k-28k BRL/mo.


Must‑haves:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

title: Auxiliar de produção de Equipamentos Eletrônicos
description:
Buscamos AUXILIAR DE PRODUÇÃO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS na Montagem de produtos eletrônicos .

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 32 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades

O “Auxiliar de Produção ” desempenha um papel fundamental na linha de produção. Suas principais atividades e responsabilidades incluem:

  • Executar a instalação de componentes, sistemas eletrônicos e equipamentos
  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Realizar atividades operacionais tais como recebimento de materiais e produtos para produção
  • Organização, limpeza e zelo pelos materiais e recursos necessários ao trabalho
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Ensino médio em andamento
  • Coordenação motora
  • Atenção concentrada
  • Senso de segurança

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • Ensino médio completo
  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência em produção e montagem de produtos

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR
  • Plano de saúde ambulatorial e odonto após contrato de experiência
  • PPLR
  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Vinculo: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada: Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho: Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a proactive DevOps Engineer who enjoys building, automating, and maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure. You take ownership of environments end to end from access management and CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes workloads and you thrive in fast-paced environments where stability, security, and scalability are critical. You’re looking for a role where you can grow your cloud expertise, influence infrastructure decisions, and collaborate closely with engineering teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services, particularly IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Solid background designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and container orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python and/or Bash (desirable).
  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, permissions, and access management.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Advogado Tributário (Remoto)
description:
Advogado Tributário


Início Imediato / 100% Remoto


Remuneração Inicial entre R$4.000 e R$5.000, a depender da experiência.


Qualificações:


  • De 2 a 5 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em contencioso tributário (judicial e administrativo) em escritório de advocacia;
  • 2 anos de experiência comprovada atuando em consultoria tributária (desejável);
  • Experiência em Big Four (diferencial);
  • Pós-graduação de Direito Tributário (diferencial);


Principais Atividades:


  • Atuar em demandas judiciais e administrativas tributárias e fiscais;
  • Analisar publicações e controlar seus respectivos prazos;
  • Prestar atendimento eficiente aos clientes, garantindo uma comunicação clara e transparente;
  • Realizar pesquisas jurídicas abrangentes para embasar estratégias de defesa;
  • Colaborar com colegas de equipe para desenvolver e implementar estratégias jurídicas eficazes;
  • Atuar na consultoria tributária envolvendo Tributos Diretos e Indiretos;
  • Elaborar respostas a consultas e memorandos sobre temas variados ligados ao Direito Tributário;
  • Avaliar regimes tributários especiais e benefícios fiscais aplicáveis;
  • Planejamento tributário estratégico, incluindo reorganizações societárias.


Sobre o Santos Varella Advocacia


  • O Santos Varella Advocacia é um escritório boutique de advocacia especializado em Direito Tributário, Direito Empresarial e Direito Civil. Com equipe de profissionais qualificados com mais de 15 anos de excelência no mercado, atuamos na consultoria e no contencioso. Nosso diferencial está na vasta experiência de nossos profissionais, cujo histórico abrange setores jurídicos de grandes escritórios e empresas multinacionais.

description:
Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software , de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Frontend.

- Lógica de Programação;

- Arquitetura de Software (noções);

- Angular (incluindo Angular 18+)

- Typescript (tipagem estática e POO)

- Javascript avançado(opcional)

- HTML e CSS

- Node.js básico (para ferramentas de build e execução de apps)

- React ou Vue (opcional)

- Experiência em otimização de performance em grandes aplicações front-end (opcional)

- Experiência em A11y (acessibilidade) (opcional)

- Integração com mensageria em tempo real (WebSockets, Pub/Sub)(opcional)

- Métodos ágeis

title: Analista de Sistemas Sr Fullstack (React Native)
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?


Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar no desenvolvimento, monitoramento e sustentação dos processos da squad , participando ativamente da evolução técnica das aplicações e garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

Principais responsabilidades

✔ Desenvolver, monitorar e sustentar aplicações da squad

✔ Atuar em ambientes cloud AWS , com foco em arquitetura e boas práticas

✔ Trabalhar com integrações backend e frontend

✔ Apoiar melhorias contínuas de performance, estabilidade e acessibilidade

✔ Atuar de forma colaborativa com o time técnico

title: Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional
description:
Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Months



This role will be SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration - experience is required.


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

* Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

* Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

* Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

* Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)

Functional Process Data Ownership


Responsibilities include:

* Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

* Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

* Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

* Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

* Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

* Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

* Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

* Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

* Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

* Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

* Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

* Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

* Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

* Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

* Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications Experience

* 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

* Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

* Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

* Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

* Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

* Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

* Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

* Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

* Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

* Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

* Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

* Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

* Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

They have a customized system, so it will take time for worker to come up to speed.

Must have strong SAP knowledge, understand fields and how they can be used.

Knowledge of master data is not critical, most data will be OTC, A/R data pricing, customer, pricing tables.

Must have recent SAP experience over the last 3 years.

description:
Project Description:

We are looking for passionate and creative developers eager to craft innovative products and embrace new technologies. You will be part of a small, agile, and highly skilled team of technologists who are building next generation of solutions for Risk Management team and Portfolio Managers.

description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Desenvolvedor Front-End Pleno
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

title: Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Mid‑Level Software Developer (Product Team) — Azure AKS

Job Location: REMOTE - Nearshore

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more of: .NET/C#, Java, or Node.js for building RESTful services.
  • Practical experience with Docker and deploying workloads to Azure AKS (Deployments, Services, Ingress, namespaces).
  • CI/CD experience (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and infrastructure automation (Helm/Kustomize; familiarity with Terraform/Bicep a plus).
  • Cloud security and configuration: Azure AD workload identity, Key Vault, App Configuration, secrets management, least privilege.
  • Observability: hands‑on with logs/metrics/traces (Azure Monitor; familiarity with Prometheus/Grafana welcomed).
  • Working knowledge of Agile practices and collaborative delivery in cross‑functional product teams.

title: React Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Join our dynamic Team as a React Developer and drive innovation in a collaborative environment. You'll enhance services, tools, and components within a collaborative Team by driving Agile solutions for internal and external challenges, ensuring top-notch software quality. Become a key player in our Core team, utilizing modern technologies to shape artifacts and support diverse groups, all while ensuring our software reaches new heights of excellence.

- Work closely with the product and design teams to achieve effective UX.

- Conduct performance optimization of applications for maximum speed and scalability.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the latest React frameworks and libraries.

- Experience with Typescript.

- Comfortable working in GMT+2 timezone.

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Desenvolvedor OCC Júnior - OSF (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios. Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono , oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering, Data Analytics, Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados.

INCREASE THE POWER OF YOUR BUSINESS.

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:

❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções em OCC;
  • Apoio na configuração, ajuste e manutenção de workflows em OSF / OSM;
  • Análise e correção de incidentes de baixa e média complexidade;
  • Suporte a ambientes produtivos;
  • Integração entre sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Consumo de Web Services REST e SOAP;
  • Execução de testes técnicos e validações funcionais;
  • Apoio na documentação técnica;
  • Trabalho colaborativo com desenvolvedores pleno e sênior.

  • Experiência com OCC (Oracle Commerce Cloud);
  • Conhecimento técnico ou funcional em OSF (Oracle Storefront Framework) / OSM Framework;
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas BSS/OSS;
  • Consumo de APIs REST e SOAP;
  • Vivência com suporte a ambientes produtivos;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum / Kanban).

❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência ou vivência em projetos de telecomunicações;
  • Facilidade de aprendizado e adaptação a novos frameworks.

❇️ O que esperamos de você – Soft Skills:

  • Colaboração;
  • Foco no cliente;
  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Visão de dono;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Trabalho em equipe.

✨ O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$39,71/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off no aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeados pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em automação inteligente com Inteligência Artificial, com atuação de ponta a ponta, da arquitetura à implementação em produção. Esse papel é estratégico na criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e inovadoras, conectando engenharia de software, IA aplicada a processos de negócio, automação de fluxos e cloud computing.


O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de agentes autônomos inteligentes, integrações complexas entre sistemas e orquestração de automações em ambientes multi-cloud, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares.


O modelo de contrato para esta oportunidade é CLT.


Somos inquietos, somos desbravadores e estamos em constante transformação.


Por isso, estamos na busca constante de crescimento do nosso time com profissionais inovadores, que desafiam os limites e estejam preparados para embarcar nessa cultura.


Seja qual for o seu gênero, orientação sexual, idade, raça, etnia, crença ou deficiência, todos são bem-vindos no nosso time.


Responsabilidades Principais


Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de automação com IA, integradas a ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).


Desenvolver, treinar e evoluir agentes autônomos e assistentes virtuais utilizando LLMs, LangChain, RAG, MCP Server e Google Agentspace.


Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados para alimentar modelos de IA e fluxos automatizados.


Integrar bancos de dados relacionais, NoSQL e vetoriais.


Desenvolver APIs e microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Python e PHP.


Aplicar engenharia de prompt e arquiteturas multi-agentes em ambientes produtivos.


Desenvolver interfaces front-end leves para monitoramento e controle das automações.


Orquestrar ambientes de Cloud e DevOps com Docker, Git e pipelines CI/CD.


Garantir governança, compliance e rastreabilidade no uso de IA (versionamento de prompts, documentação e observabilidade).


Atuar em squads multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de negócio, design e tecnologia.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)


Inglês avançado

Experiência sólida em automação inteligente com IA


Vivência com LLMs e frameworks de IA (LangChain, RAG, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)


Experiência com ferramentas de automação: n8n, Power Automate, Make ou Zapier


Desenvolvimento back-end com Node.js e/ou Python


Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços e integração de sistemas


Experiência com Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP)


Stack Técnica Desejável

IA & LLMs


OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, LangChain, RAG, Banco de Dados Vetorial, MCP Server


Automação & Orquestração


n8n, Power Automate, Make, Zapier


Agentes Autônomos, Engenharia de Prompt


Back-End


Node.js, Python, PHP


Front-End


ReactJS, Bootstrap, JavaScript


Cloud & DevOps


Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud


Git (GitHub / Bitbucket), Docker, CI/CD


Banco de Dados


SQL Server, Cosmos DB, MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL


Ferramentas Complementares


Postman, Grafana, Kibana, AI Search


Terraform (diferencial)


Diferenciais

Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud e híbridos.


Integrações com CRM, ERP e Martech (Salesforce, SAP BTP, RD Station, HubSpot).


Certificações em Cloud ou IA (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).


Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em fluxos automatizados mensuráveis.


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido (1x por semana presencial) no endereço: Vila Nova Conceição, São Paulo/SP


Perfil Comportamental

Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural.


Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.


Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade.


Interesse contínuo por inovação e evolução em IA.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Especialista (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de

software, dados e integrações com IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;
  • Atuar de forma hands on no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas, mantendo proximidade com o código e com os problemas reais do produto;
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas, considerando trade-offs de qualidade, prazo, custo, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto operacional;
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura de aplicações, dados e integrações, garantindo consistência, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;
  • Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataformas quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, investigando causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado, arquitetura, dados e IA, disseminando conhecimento no time;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE) e API First;

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;

● Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;

● Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud);

● NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes;

● IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;

● Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes.

title: Full Stack AI Software Engineers
description:
We are hiring three Full-Stack AI Software Engineers (remote, US-based client) with 4+ years of experience in software and AI agent development.

The team is small, fast-moving, and highly hands-on. Engineers will design, build, deploy, monitor, and support an AI-driven platform. You will work across the stack, from backend services to AI agent tuning to infrastructure automation. Candidates must be comfortable owning features end‑to‑end, working independently, and collaborating with distributed teams.

Our client develops AI agents that automate lead follow-up and customer inquiries, allowing in‑person staff to focus on high‑value interactions. The platform will be white-labeled, so engineers must build scalable, configurable, API‑driven solutions with strong attention to performance, reliability, and edge‑case handling.


Responsibilities:


Senior Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Lead by example—mentor and guide less experienced engineers
  • Provide architectural direction and ensure technical excellence
  • Drive core business initiatives and scalable AI agent development


Mid‑Level Software Engineers

In addition to the Core responsibilities below:

  • Work independently and unblock yourself using AI and other resources
  • Seek guidance when needed—propose solution options, not just problems


Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver AI agents and related platform features
  • Integrate platform services with CRMs and third‑party APIs
  • Use AI tools, frameworks, and LLMs to enhance workflows, automate tasks, and optimize customer interactions
  • Build and maintain /Django backend services and scalable REST APIs
  • Conduct hands‑on coding, code reviews, and contribute to system architecture
  • Implement automated QA checks, assist with manual QA when needed, and build scripts/tools to improve testing coverage and reliability
  • Participate in real‑time monitoring and automated load balancing of AI agent infrastructure
  • Diagnose and resolve defects—identify root causes and implement long‑term fixes
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to technical and non‑technical stakeholders


Required Experience (Must-Have)

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Minimum 4+ years of Software Engineering Experience
  • Frontend experience should include one of: React, Redux, Mui, react-query, react-table, or Husky
  • Backend experience should include: Python, Django, Postgres, Celery, RabbitMQ
  • CI/CD and infrastructure experience should include: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Gitlab
  • Experienced in performing comprehensive unit testing, collaborating with QA to ensure the team achieves coverage goals, and assisting with automated test development as needed
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG pipelines, model selection, and AI optimization
  • Strong experience building and maintaining REST APIs with robust edge‑case handling and diagnostic logging
  • Proven skill integrating systems via APIs (CRMs strongly preferred)
  • Successful track record in high‑growth lean startup environments
  • Ability to make independent decisions in fast‑changing contexts
  • Experience working in fully remote distributed engineering teams
  • Familiarity with Agile project management and defect tracking tools
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem‑solving abilities


Preferred Experience (desired but not required)

  • Technical or engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with white‑label architectures
  • Exposure to AI agent orchestration tools or workflow engines
  • Experience with test automation frameworks


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

• Atuar na prospecção e atendimento de clientes externos.

• Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais para apresentação de produtos e soluções.

• Elaborar propostas comerciais e acompanhar negociações até o fechamento.

• Manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes, garantindo satisfação e fidelização.

• Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas técnicas e de engenharia para oferecer soluções personalizadas.

• Formação superior em Engenharia (Mecatrônica, Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas).

title: SAP Coupa Source to Pay
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Coupa - Source to Pay who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

\"Responsibilities for this role include:

Developer with knowledge Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)

Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)

Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.

Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.

Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.

Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.

Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects

Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders\"

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Talent Acquisition Manager - NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead Python
description:
Tech Lead - Python


A Shipay simplifica a forma de as empresas receberem e pagarem por meios digitais, como Pix, Bolepix e Carteiras Digitais. Com a regulamentação da Duplicata Escritural, vamos viabilizar o Pagamento em Duas Etapas, além de um hub de escrituração de duplicatas. 


Buscamos um(a) Líder Técnico(a) para guiar nossa equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções de alta qualidade, escaláveis e eficientes. Importante: Este papel foca na excelência tecnológica e mentoria técnica, não sendo responsável pela gestão de pessoas .


Responsabilidades


  • Excelência Técnica: Projetar, implementar e testar serviços de back-end de forma iterativa, garantindo a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Desenvolvimento Ativo: Atuar de forma \"hands-on\" no desenvolvimento de aplicações distribuídas e assíncronas, sendo a referência técnica para o time nas entregas das sprints.
  • Padrões e Práticas: Definir e implementar as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, aplicando Design e Enterprise Patterns.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Realizar estimativas de projetos, identificar riscos técnicos e criar planos de mitigação para débitos técnicos.
  • Mentoria e Resolução: Atuar como mentor técnico para o desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe e resolver problemas técnicos complexos.

title: Senior Growth Manager (Brazil)
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Portuguese and English.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Sobre nós:

A Unlimitail é uma joint venture entre o Grupo Carrefour e o Grupo Publicis, que tem como objetivo atender ao crescente mercado de retail media na Europa e América Latina, desenvolvendo soluções eficazes para as principais necessidades do mercado: vender mais, personalização, oportunidades para as marcas, medição e transparência e presença omnicanal.

A empresa se destaca no mercado hoje graças à sua experiência e tecnologia de publicidade de ponta, CitrusAd powered by Epsilon, que unifica recursos onsite e offsite. Além disso, a Unlimitail oferece alcance global e dados de alta qualidade, com mais de 1,5 bilhão de visualizações de página mensais e um banco de dados de mais de 120 milhões de clientes endereçáveis em todo o mundo.



Contexto da Vaga de Emprego:

Você fará parte do Data Pipelines Squad, responsável por ingerir, preparar e normalizar fontes de dados que alimentam produtos de analytics, IA e retail media. O time atua com Arquitetura Medallion (Bronze > Silver), e a plataforma central de dados é construída sobre a Google Cloud, com forte foco em BigQuery e dbt para transformações e datasets governados.



Missão:

Como Senior Data Engineer, você será responsável por construir e operar pipelines confiáveis que movem dados de fontes brutas para camadas curadas e reutilizáveis. Garantirá a qualidade, consistência e performance dos conjuntos de dados utilizados pelos times de analytics e data science. Você será uma referência técnica sênior dentro do squad, influenciando arquitetura e padrões, além de trabalhar de forma próxima com stakeholders globais, utilizando inglês no dia a dia.



Principais Atividades:

Ingestão e Preparação de Dados

  • Consumir dados de múltiplas fontes (APIs, arquivos, bancos de dados, parceiros e sistemas internos);
  • Implementar padrões de ingestão na camada Bronze (dados brutos, auditáveis e reproduzíveis).

Transformações Medallion com dbt

  • Desenvolver e manter projetos em dbt para construção de datasets curados;
  • Desenhar e implementar transformações de Bronze para Silver (dados limpos, normalizados e conformados);
  • Definir modelos reutilizáveis, macros e documentação alinhados ao consumo analítico.

Engenharia e Otimização em BigQuery

  • Construir e otimizar datasets no BigQuery;
  • Melhorar performance, particionamento, clusterização e eficiência de custos;
  • Garantir design escalável para grandes volumes de dados e ciclos frequentes de atualização.

Qualidade e Governança de Dados

  • Implementar checagens de qualidade de dados (atualização, completude, variação de schema, anomalias);
  • Garantir rastreabilidade, versionamento e clareza de ownership dos principais datasets;
  • Manter documentação e padrões para ativos de dados compartilhados.

Colaboração e Enablement

  • Atuar em parceria com times de Analytics/BI (consumidores de Looker e Looker Studio) e Data Science;
  • Alinhar com stakeholders de Produto e Negócio, traduzindo necessidades em contratos de dados;
  • Trabalhar diariamente com um squad global (Brasil + França), em inglês.



Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Forte experiência como Senior Data Engineer;
  • SQL avançado;
  • Experiência prática sólida com dbt (requisito central);
  • Forte experiência com BigQuery (modelagem, otimização e controle de custos);
  • Experiência no desenho de pipelines ELT confiáveis e camadas de dados curadas;
  • Boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, code review, documentação);
  • Excelente comunicação e gestão de stakeholders;
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).



Habilidades Desejadas:

  • Experiência com Terraform ou Infrastructure as Code (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce, marketplace ou retail media;
  • CI/CD para workflows de dados;
  • Vivência com padrões orientados a eventos ou near real-time;
  • Francês será um diferencial.



Perfil Preferencial:

  • Contribuidor individual sênior;
  • Data engineer com mentalidade de plataforma;
  • Forte experiência prática com dbt e BigQuery;
  • Confortável em construir e manter camadas Bronze e Silver em uma Arquitetura Medallion;
  • Foco em confiabilidade, qualidade e escalabilidade dos dados;
  • Confortável em atuar nos bastidores, habilitando squads de analytics e IA;
  • Forte senso de ownership sobre os principais ativos de dados;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes globais e complexos;
  • Comunicação clara, colaborando com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Influencia arquitetura e padrões por excelência técnica, não por hierarquia.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is the platform for experts and businesses who take education seriously. In a world where anyone can ask AI for information, we're the home for those who educate with purpose, modernity, and humanity. We help experts and businesses scale their impact and operations through courses, coaching, and digital downloads that students actually love. From a finance expert teaching Python for investment analysis to a multilingual coach offering business Spanish for executives, Teachable powers human-led learning that drives student trust, connection, and results. With a sleek, intuitive interface and AI as a time-saving partner, the platform enables transformative education rooted in real-world experience. Teachable experts have lived it—that's why they teach it.Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey?

Part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators, experts, and businesses earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to cement itself as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize student outcomes, business growth, and flexibility. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of real-world learning to shape the future, we want you on our team!


About your team


Our Brand & Content team is a group of social media experts, newsletter writers, designers, copywriters, and event pros—all working together to build a world-class brand creators love. We focus on growing Teachable’s reach, connecting with new and existing audiences, and using content, design, and in-person experiences to drive awareness, generate leads, and deepen engagement.


What is the role?


We’re looking for a highly creative, results-oriented Brand Designer to join our Brand + Content Team. This role is for a strategic thinker with strong design execution skills and a deep understanding of brand systems. You’ll help shape and scale our visual storytelling, building cohesive brand expressions that drive engagement and recognition across campaigns, events, and experiences.

This role focuses on evolving and extending visual identity systems and applying brand guidelines across digital and physical touchpoints. You’ll design multi-channel marketing assets spanning email, paid media, social, web, and print, with an eye for consistency and craft. The ideal candidate also brings strengths in web and motion design to support a multidisciplinary team.

While an individual contributor role, you’ll collaborate closely with other designers—offering thoughtful critique, feedback, and informal mentorship—and partner cross-functionally to create design that resonates with our audience and reinforces our brand story.


In this role, you will:


  • Build upon and evolve brand guidelines by establishing sophisticated visual systems that align with business goals.
  • Proactively propose solutions to help improve project outcomes across a range of project types, including marketing and product.
  • Conceptualize and execute high-impact design across diverse formats: digital & print, event identities, promotional assets, and marketing materials that extend the Teachable brand.
  • Demonstrate versatility in applying design thinking to varied channels while maintaining cohesion across all output.
  • Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with stakeholders and cross-functional stakeholders including web, product marketing, growth, and events—to ensure creative execution aligns with GTM strategy, brand objectives, and campaign goals.
  • Provide mentorship to junior designers on the team.
  • Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
  • Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
  • Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows


What you’ll bring:


  • Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
  • Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
  • Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

  • Present creative concepts to teams across the organization in a clear and compelling manner.
  • Strive to maintain the brand standard across all projects and ensure consistency.
  • Manage end-to-end production for creative deliverables, including preparing files for presentations, cross functional partners, print vendors, and event production.
  • Build trusted relationships with cross-functional peers through clear communication, curiosity, and accountability.
  • Contribute motion design and animation to campaigns, launches, or brand moments that deepen storytelling and audience engagement.
  • Stay up to date on design trends and tools, with a particular focus on leveraging AI in design workflows


What you’ll bring:


  • Experience: 5+ years of visual design experience, with a strong focus on branding and performance marketing
  • Experience working collaboratively alongside fellow designers and/or offering mentorship/coaching to other designers
  • Skills: Excels in the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Portfolio: A strong portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and assets (including email, social, paid advertising, print, etc.) , plus motion design
  • Strong design sensibility with attention to detail, typography, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to adapt to brand guidelines while pushing creative boundaries; experience refining and scaling brand guidelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work cross-functionally with marketers, designers, and content creators.
  • Self-starter with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Understanding: Demonstrated understanding of brand identities, digital marketing principles, website design best practices, and performance marketing metrics.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate design concepts to stakeholders and gather feedback.
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and adapt to changing priorities.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working in SaaS, edtech, or within the creator economy.
  • Familiarity with video editing tools (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or similar).
  • Knowledge of current trends in motion design, animation, and paid and social media.


While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

description:
